definitions.explanation: A mental concept, plan, or point of view. The noun form of the verb {考|かんが}える (to think).

examples.japanese: ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{考|かんが}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦あなた→あなた：02565_anata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{考|かんが}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かせて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{考|かんが}え⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}います→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{考|かんが}え⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think that idea is very good.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{考|かんが}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{考|かんが}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}しましょう→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: After hearing his thoughts, let's also share our ideas.

notes:
{考|かんが}え is a noun meaning thought, idea, or opinion. Derived from the verb ⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ (to think).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {考|かんが}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have an idea/thought
- {考|かんが}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to ask for someone's thoughts
- {考|かんが}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧: to express one's thoughts
- {考|かんが}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧: an idea comes to mind
- {考|かんが}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: to change one's mind

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {考|かんが}え: thought, idea (general, includes plans)
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧: opinion (more formal, stated view)
- ⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧: idea (creative, solution-oriented)
- ⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧: feeling, thought (more emotional)

USAGE:
{考|かんが}え is broader than ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧. It can refer to plans, ideas, opinions, or general thoughts.
